findings.title: Field techs report poor cell signal at remote/desert install sites
findings.description: Priya notes field technicians occasionally grumble about signal quality at remote install sites. She and Derek both attribute this to cell carrier coverage gaps in the desert/remote areas, not the BetterBark product. Priya explicitly frames this as not being BetterBark's issue.
findings.quote: The field techs occasionally grumble about signal at remote install sites, but that's cell coverage in the desert, not you.
findings.severity_reason: Customer explicitly attributes the cause to external cell carrier coverage, not the product, and does not request any product change.
findings.match_note: Not a product defect; customer self-identifies root cause as carrier network coverage outside BetterBark's control.

findings.title: Customer welcomes offline-usage tips as workaround for remote-site connectivity
findings.description: In response to Derek offering to send tips for using the app in low-signal situations (leveraging existing mobile content caching), Priya says it would be handy since some commercial sites are far from cell towers. This is a stopgap/workaround for the connectivity issue raised at L51, not a distinct product ask.
findings.quote: That'd actually be handy, some of our commercial sites are genuinely in the middle of nowhere, twenty miles past the last cell tower.
findings.severity_reason: Acceptance of a suggested workaround for an already-noted, non-product connectivity issue; no independent defect or feature gap identified.
findings.match_note: Workaround/stopgap for the connectivity complaint at L51; not a separate issue to file.
